# cfbd-python 5.32.1 (reference only)

Source of the `cfbd` Python client, version 5.32.1 (generated by OpenAPI Generator from
OpenAPI document 5.32.1). It was copied from the copy installed in the legacy `venv/` at
`venv/lib/python3.14/site-packages/cfbd/`. That environment was deleted on 2026-10-13, so
this copy is now the only one.

**Do not import or install this.** It pins `pydantic<2` and validates every row strictly.
The project calls the REST API directly with httpx. Use this copy as the schema and
parameter reference:

- `cfbd/api/*_api.py`: endpoint paths, query parameter wire names, required params, descriptions
- `cfbd/models/*.py`: response field names (camelCase aliases), types, nullability

The upstream `docs/*Api.md` files are not included, because the installed wheel doesn't ship
them. The API modules' docstrings and `Field(description=...)` annotations hold the same
information.
